concerns.text: FR-008 mandates the system MUST 'execute the original AXPO agent (or a cached simulation)' to generate ground-truth outcomes. Task T008-impl only defines a schema and mentions 'load cached simulation' but lacks a concrete task to implement the execution logic or the simulation runner itself. Task T022 references T008-impl to 'generate or load' data but does not assign the implementation of the generation logic. The 'execution' requirement is missing a concrete implementation task, risking a silent relaxation of the FR.

FR-007 explicitly requires 'automatically downsampling the dataset to 300 records if the full dataset exceeds these constraints' (memory > 7GB or N > 500). Tasks T035 and T036 only state 'Enforce memory limit' and 'Add dataset downsampling logic' without specifying the trigger conditions (N > 500, memory > 7GB) or the target count (300). This omission allows the implementer to choose arbitrary thresholds, violating the specific constraint in FR-007.

FR-010 requires the system to 'halt and report "Insufficient Sample Size for Power Analysis"' if N < 30. Tasks T017 and T024 mention checking N ≥ 30 but do not explicitly assign the task to implement the specific error message string or the 'halt' behavior (raising a specific exception vs. logging). This risks inconsistent error reporting and a failure to strictly enforce the halt condition.

FR-003 requires computing the 'centroid of the retrieved tool description strings' using the SAME encoder. Task T014 handles retrieval, and T015 handles embedding the 'thinking prefix' and 'calculate cosine similarity', but neither task explicitly assigns the logic to 'embed the retrieved tool descriptions' and 'compute the centroid'. The centroid calculation is a distinct, required step in FR-003 that is currently implied but not explicitly assigned as a deliverable, risking a semantic gap in the implementation.
